mapper.select: SELECT t.TERMS_NM AS "termsNm", t.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "termsEngAbrvNm", t.DOMAIN_NM AS "domainNm" FROM TB_TERMS_WORDS tw JOIN TB_TERMS t ON tw.TERMS_ID = t.TERMS_ID WHERE tw.WORD_ID = #{wordId} ORDER BY t.TERMS_NM
mapper.sql: COALESCE(M.DICT_ID, (SELECT SD.DICT_ID FROM TB_STD_DICT SD WHERE SD.DEFAULT_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SD.DICT_ID LIMIT 1))

M.DM_NM AS "dataModelNm" ,A.DM_ID AS "dmId" ,A.OBJ_OWNER AS "objOwner" ,A.OBJ_NM AS "objNm" ,A.ATTR_NM AS "attrNm" ,A.ATTR_NM_KR AS "attrNmKr" ,A.DATA_TYPE AS "dataType" ,A.DATA_LEN AS "dataLen" ,COALESCE(A.TERMS_STND_YN, 'N') AS "termsStndYn"

JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL M ON M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(M.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A ON A.DM_ID = M.DM_ID AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(A.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM TB_WORD W
AND W.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM = ANY(string_to_array(UPPER(TRIM(A.ATTR_NM)), '_')) WHERE W.WORD_ID = #{wordId} AND = W.DICT_ID ORDER BY M.DM_NM, A.OBJ_OWNER, A.OBJ_NM, A.ATTR_ORD LIMIT 2000
SELECT t.TERMS_ID AS "termsId", t.TERMS_NM AS "termsNm", t.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "termsEngAbrvNm" FROM TB_TERMS t WHERE t.DOMAIN_NM = #{domainNm} AND t.DICT_ID = #{dictId} ORDER BY t.TERMS_NM

SELECT T.TERMS_NM AS "termsNm" ,T.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "termsEngAbrvNm" ,CASE WHEN TRIM(A.ATTR_NM) = T.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM THEN 'ENG' ELSE 'KR' END AS "matchType" , FROM TB_TERMS T
AND (TRIM(A.ATTR_NM) = T.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM OR TRIM(A.ATTR_NM_KR) = T.TERMS_NM) WHERE T.TERMS_ID IN #{id} AND = T.DICT_ID ORDER BY 3, M.DM_NM, A.OBJ_OWNER, A.OBJ_NM, A.ATTR_ORD LIMIT 2000

SELECT TERMS_ID AS "termsId", TERMS_NM AS "termsNm", TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "termsEngAbrvNm", DOMAIN_NM AS "domainNm", APRV_YN AS "aprvYn" FROM TB_TERMS WHERE DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND CODE_GRP = #{codeGrp} ORDER BY TERMS_NM

SELECT T.TERMS_NM AS "termsNm", T.CODE_GRP AS "codeGrp", COALESCE(T.CODE_TP, 'SINGLE') AS "codeTp", 'CHILD' AS "rel" FROM TB_TERMS T WHERE T.DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND T.PARENT_CODE_GRP = #{codeGrp} UNION ALL SELECT T.TERMS_NM, T.CODE_GRP, COALESCE(T.CODE_TP, 'SINGLE'), 'INTEG' FROM TB_CODE_INTEG I JOIN TB_TERMS T ON T.DICT_ID = I.DICT_ID AND T.CODE_GRP = I.CODE_GRP WHERE I.DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND I.SUB_CODE_GRP = #{codeGrp} ORDER BY 4, 1

SELECT W.WORD_ID AS "wordId", W.WORD_NM AS "wordNm", W.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "wordEngAbrvNm", W.WORD_CLSF_YN AS "wordClsfYn" FROM TB_TERMS_WORDS TW JOIN TB_WORD W ON W.WORD_ID = TW.WORD_ID WHERE TW.TERMS_ID = #{termsId} ORDER BY TW.WORD_ORD
